verdict.rationale: Discord's official developer docs describe a REST API with bot-token and OAuth2 bearer-token authentication (scoped access), plus a Gateway API for receiving channel/message events, which together enable an agent to read and post messages via the official API; a live probe confirms the API endpoint is functional. Missing for 10: no explicit documented example of the messages endpoint itself or an independent hands-on report of an AI agent using scoped tokens to read/post messages end-to-end.
